role_agent_name: Delegate services and community relations officer (COMM)
abstract: Maintains historical delegate satisfaction and regional venue perception indices
system_message:
You are the delegate services and community relations officer (COMM), responsible for maintaining historical delegate satisfaction records, regional venue perception indices, and monitoring concierge digital desk traffic for candidate convention facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Concierge digital desk traffic（INFO）
information_points.content:
COMM-INFO-CLU：Visitor portal server metrics for the Cascadia Waterfront Expo Hall indicate that 1,200 daily mobile inquiries are served across its digital kiosk network per convention day.
COMM-INFO-R5R：At the Pacific Rim Maritime Pavilion, the digital information kiosk network handles 800 daily mobile inquiries served per convention day.
COMM-INFO-0ES：At the Bayside Oceanarium Conference Center, concierge digital desk metrics record 1,600 daily mobile inquiries served through the automated attendee kiosk network per convention day.

information_points.title: Maintains historical delegate satisfaction and regional venue perception indices（SURV）
information_points.content:
COMM-SURV-7O8：For the Cascadia Waterfront Expo Hall, records covering major academic conventions in the preceding 36 months reflect a historical delegate satisfaction rating of 78 % positive evaluation for venue comfort and navigation.
COMM-SURV-ZCG：According to the survey archive of major academic conventions held over the preceding 36 months, the Bayside Oceanarium Conference Center attained a historical delegate satisfaction rating of 94 % positive response on venue comfort and navigation.
COMM-SURV-ORA：For the Pacific Rim Maritime Pavilion, the historical delegate satisfaction rating recorded across major academic conventions hosted in the preceding 36 months is 78 % based on attendee positive responses regarding overall venue comfort and navigation.
